visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with vibrant pink hair tied in a ponytail, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a denim mini skirt, stands on an outdoor sidewalk. She smiles and gestures with high energy towards the camera. In the background, a street-side food stall with a yellow sign is visible, where an older man in a blue t-shirt is working. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (2) The camera focuses on the food stall sign which reads "大同 鍋貼 水餃". An older man in a blue shirt and a green face mask is seen placing dumplings into a large, round iron griddle. The background shows the interior of the small stall with various cooking utensils and plastic bags. (3) A younger man wearing a grey t-shirt and a face mask uses two metal spatulas to flip and arrange the dumplings on the griddle. Steam rises from the hot surface. The dumplings are golden brown on one side. (4) The scene shifts to the interior of a car where the pink-haired woman is now sitting. She holds a takeout box of potstickers drizzled with sauce. She uses chopsticks to eat, showing very expressive facial movements and looking directly into the camera. Digital graphics of steam and sparkles appear around the food. (5) Another woman with dark hair appears briefly, also eating from a takeout box inside the car. The editing is fast-paced with frequent cuts between the woman talking and close-ups of the food being prepared and eaten.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice begins narrating at a fast pace with positive, bright intonation. An upbeat pop-electronic background track with a prominent synthesizer melody and a steady drum machine beat starts simultaneously. The atmosphere is clear with very minimal outdoor background hum. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The speaker continues with high enthusiasm as she introduces the food stall. Faint incidental sounds of cooking and metal-on-metal clinking from the stall are heard beneath the music. (3) A 'pop' sound effect occurs. The female voice expresses excitement as the sound shifts to a car interior, characterized by a drier acoustic. Sounds of chopsticks clicking against a plastic container and audible munching/eating noises are clearly present. (4) A 'ding' sound effect and sparkle SFX accompany the description of the food's texture. The music continues consistently as the speaker's pitch fluctuates dramatically to emphasize her enjoyment. The narration remains dense and highly expressive until the end.
